sides.text: A company wants to avoid buying servers and pay only for what it uses. Which model fits?
B. Cloud computing

more.text: Cloud computing is on-demand and billed by usage.

sides.text: In an IaaS deployment, who is responsible for patching the guest operating system?
A. The customer

more.text: In IaaS the provider secures the infrastructure; the customer manages the OS and above.

sides.text: Servers and networks are deployed from version-controlled templates. What is this called?
B. Infrastructure as code

more.text: IaC provisions infrastructure from machine-readable files.

sides.text: A critical system has no connection to any other network, including the internet. What is this called?
C. Air-gapped

more.text: An air gap is complete physical disconnection.

sides.text: Which technology separates the control plane from the data plane so a controller programs network devices?
C. SDN

more.text: Software-defined networking centralizes control in a controller.

sides.text: A factory control system can't be patched without stopping production. What is the best approach?
options: Connect it to the internet for updates
Isolate it and add compensating controls

sides.text: D. Isolate it and add compensating controls

more.text: When patching isn't possible, isolation and monitoring reduce risk.

sides.text: Which firewall failure mode prioritizes security over availability?
D. Fail-closed

more.text: Fail-closed blocks traffic when the device fails.

sides.text: A sensor receives a copy of traffic from a switch and can alert but not block. Which deployment is this?
A. Passive tap or monitor

more.text: A tap or monitor sees a copy of traffic and can't block it.

sides.text: Which device distributes requests across several web servers and skips failed ones?
C. Load balancer

more.text: A load balancer spreads traffic and uses health checks.

sides.text: A firewall inspects HTTP traffic to block SQL injection against a web app. Which device is this?
C. WAF

more.text: A web application firewall works at Layer 7 against web attacks.

sides.text: A device must authenticate through a RADIUS server before a switch port forwards traffic. Which standard is this?

more.text: 802.1X provides port-based network access control.

sides.text: Which VPN setup sends only corporate-bound traffic through the tunnel?
C. Split tunnel

more.text: A split tunnel sends only designated traffic through the VPN.

sides.text: Branch offices use low-cost internet links managed centrally by policy. Which technology is this?
D. SD-WAN

more.text: SD-WAN routes traffic over multiple links by policy with central management.

sides.text: A company labels data whose loss would halt operations. Which classification fits?
D. Critical

more.text: Critical data is essential to operations.

sides.text: A US firm must keep EU customer data inside the EU. Which concept applies?
D. Data sovereignty

more.text: Data is subject to the laws of where it's stored or processed.

sides.text: Data being processed in memory is in which state?
B. Data in use

more.text: In use means actively processed, such as in RAM.

sides.text: A call center agent sees only the last four digits of a card number. Which technique is this?
C. Masking

more.text: Masking hides parts of a value in display.

sides.text: Which recovery site offers the fastest failover but costs the most?
A. Hot site

more.text: A hot site is fully equipped with current data.

sides.text: Which backup type needs the last full backup plus only the most recent backup to restore?
A. Differential

more.text: Differential backups contain all changes since the last full backup.

sides.text: A company can tolerate losing at most 15 minutes of data. Which metric states this?
A. RPO

more.text: RPO is the maximum acceptable data loss measured in time.

sides.text: A team talks through a ransomware scenario in a meeting without touching any systems. Which test is this?
B. Tabletop exercise

more.text: A tabletop is a discussion-based walkthrough.

sides.text: Which power component bridges a short outage until generators start?
A. UPS

more.text: A UPS provides immediate battery power for short outages.

sides.text: A company uses two different cloud providers to avoid depending on one. What is this called?
B. Multi-cloud

more.text: Multi-cloud uses more than one provider for resilience.

sides.text: Which appliance sits in front of internal servers, hiding them and distributing requests?
B. Reverse proxy

more.text: A reverse proxy fronts servers. A forward proxy fronts users.

sides.text: Which secure protocol and port replace Telnet?
A. SSH on port 22

more.text: SSH encrypts remote administration and uses port 22.
